question.text: Surveillance measures applied by the clearing corporation and SEBI to equity derivatives positions include:

answer.text: Clearing corporation online position monitoring, alerts at predetermined benchmarks, MWPL alerts, and intraday position-limit snapshots
Manual review of trades only at month-end
Surveillance only during market-wide circuit breaker events
Monitoring only institutional trades, not retail

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook explains that the clearing corporation monitors member open positions on an online real-time basis and dispatches alert messages once predetermined benchmarks of the prescribed position limits are reached. Market Wide Position Limit (MWPL) breaches trigger alert messages, and clearing corporations also take random intraday snapshots of client and member positions to monitor compliance with position limits. The Trap: Month-end manual reviews, circuit-breaker-only surveillance, or institutional-only monitoring contradict the continuous online monitoring described in the workbook. Note: Anchor surveillance to the workbook quartet: online position monitoring, predetermined alert benchmarks, MWPL alerts, and intraday position snapshots.
